name: ControlNet
description: 提供姿态检测和 ControlNet 控制能力，支持 OpenPose、Canny、Depth 等多种 ControlNet 类型

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: 操作类型: status, list_types, detect_pose, load_pipeline

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: 输入图片路径 (detect_pose 操作)

inputs.name: image_path
inputs.description: 输入图片路径 (detect_pose 操作, 同 image)

inputs.name: output_path
inputs.description: 输出图片路径 (detect_pose 操作)

inputs.name: model_path
inputs.description: SD 模型路径 (load_pipeline 操作)

inputs.name: controlnet_type
inputs.description: ControlNet 类型: openpose, openpose_full, dwpose, canny, hed, lineart, depth, normal, mlsd

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: 执行状态: success 或 error

outputs.name: output_path
outputs.description: 生成的 ControlNet 控制图路径 (detect_pose 操作)

outputs.name: types
outputs.description: 所有支持的 ControlNet 类型列表 (list_types 操作)

outputs.name: dependencies
outputs.description: 依赖检查状态 (status 操作)
